responsibility: Implements global RTL constant and copy propagation over the CFG using GCSE-style dataflow on assignment expressions of the form DEST := SRC. The file owns the cprop hash tables, occurrence records, implicit-set discovery, local and global propagation logic, and conditional-jump bypassing support, using cselib and LCM/dataflow infrastructure to compute available assignments and then rewrite insns while tracking statistics; it drives the "cprop" RTL pass distinct from local CSE and PRE.
